title: This might be useful for Minecraft builders who enjoy agentic work
author: Acclynn
selftext:
I hope this is not too out of place for this sub? There's just many Minecraft mapmakers who are designing their own games inside Minecraft, so yeah that's why I thought about putting it here

This mod is basically WorldEdit but with AI : First off you select your region (by picking two corners or just by looking where you want your structure to be), then you prompt in a chat command. That prompt is sent to the agent along with the selected region, and the agent work in the background then deliver its result and you get a reconstitution of what it did.

Github: [https://github.com/Ni-Cobra/worldprompt](https://github.com/Ni-Cobra/worldprompt)

Full showcase video: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1TMD-y\_XeXk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1TMD-y_XeXk)

comments.author: hottpockets
comments.body: Is this something that could work with a local agent?

replies.author: Acclynn
replies.body: It could actually, the mod forwards the payload to an app that uses Claude or Codex CLI, but it could be Ollama as well
